  manager        + 2 checks

  what to do
    decrypted secrets live on memory-backed storage
      nothing to mount: this platform has no memory-backed filesystem, and secrets.disk-encryption
      reports what protects the disk
    root runs a docker CLI only root can replace
      remove the helper from /Users/misery7100/.docker/config.json and run `sudo docker --config
      /Users/misery7100/.docker login <registry>`, which then stores the credential where the
      manager reads it
    container registry is reachable
      check network access and registry credentials (`docker login`); updates will fail while this
      is unreachable
    every named volume is covered by a backup
      an excluded volume is the vendor saying its backup hook owns that data; a bind mount is yours
      to copy. Make sure something does.
    launchd jobs are installed and enabled
      run `morzer init --repair --install-units` to put it back, or `morzer config set
      backup.scheduled=false` if this machine's backups are handled elsewhere
    a recent backup exists
      take one with `morzer backup`, and enable the backup timer
